name: Okta
tagline: Enterprise identity and access management APIs for auth, users, and MFA
description: Okta provides cloud-based identity and access management (IAM) APIs for authentication, user lifecycle, multi-factor authentication (MFA), SSO, and directory management. Organizations use Okta as an identity provider with REST APIs for managing users, groups, applications, and sessions, plus OIDC/OAuth 2.0 endpoints for modern authentication flows.

auth.details: SSWS API token via Authorization: SSWS {token} header, or OAuth 2.0 Bearer tokens for scoped API access; tokens created in Admin Console

pricing.free_tier_limits: Integrator Free Plan: 10 active users, 5 Workflows; may deactivate after 180 consecutive days without a user sign-in unless an app is submitted to the OIN
pricing.paid_plans: Paid commercial plans available for Workforce Identity and Customer Identity; pricing and API capacity vary by product, licenses, and add-ons — see okta.com/pricing or contact sales

rate_limits: Published: org-wide, concurrent, and per-endpoint limits (e.g. Users API); rate-limit headers X-Rate-Limit-Limit/Remaining/Reset; see developer.okta.com rate-limits docs
use_cases: list and search users in an Okta org
create or update a user profile and credentials
enroll or verify multi-factor authentication factors
manage groups and app assignments for access control
authenticate users via OIDC/OAuth 2.0 and session APIs
